def count_words(text: str) -> int:
    """Count words in a note, ignoring comment lines (first non-blank char is '#')."""
    total = 0
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.lstrip().startswith('#'):
            continue
        total += len(line.split())
    return total
E
cat >> tests/test_wordcount.py <<'E'


def test_indented_comment_line_is_skipped():
    assert count_words('   \t# note here\nhello\n') == 1


def test_hash_after_words_is_not_a_comment():
    assert count_words('hello # world\n') == 3


def test_words_separated_by_any_whitespace_run():
    assert count_words('a  b\t\tc \t d\ne\r\nf') == 6


def test_empty_and_blank_text():
    assert count_words('') == 0
    assert count_words('  \n\t\n') == 0


def test_only_comments():
    assert count_words('# a\n  # b c\n#d') == 0
E
